practice_en: rearing temperature effect on disease susceptibility
practice_zh: 养殖水温对疾病易感性的影响

grouping.reason: Members 0, 1 and 2 are mostly about crucian carp reared at different water temperatures (e.g. 18/20 vs 30/33°C) and the resulting infection susceptibility, while member 3 is low-temperature pesticide resistance and cold tolerance, a different topic; claims on pesticide toxicity, seasonal outbreaks, tumour regression, CyHV temperature ranges, a single 28°C holding tank and a generic adaptation statement are not about this practice.

basis.summary: The statement rests on measured claims from four papers (S5013, S5017, S5200, S5332) that mostly describe metabolic shifts at high temperature, with only C60695 giving a welfare-relevant outcome (lowest survival at 30°C); the other claims are method notes, figure legends or temperature records, so I left them out and noted that disease susceptibility is not directly measured.

statement_en: The claims mostly describe metabolic changes in crucian carp reared at high temperatures (30–33°C) compared with 18°C: increased spleen enzyme activity and TCA cycle upregulation, lower lipid and maltose abundance, and many metabolites decreased. One paper reports the lowest survival at 30°C versus 18 and 24°C, and another says changes were stronger at higher temperatures; none directly measure disease susceptibility or water quality.
statement_zh: 这些结论大多只是描述鲫在高温(30–33°C)与18°C相比的代谢变化:脾脏酶活性升高、三羧酸循环上调、脂质和麦芽糖丰度下降、多种代谢物减少。有一篇报告称30°C下存活率比18°C和24°C低,另一篇称温度越高变化越明显;但没有结论直接测定疾病易感性或水质。

statement_en: In one study of crucian carp, alkaline water (pH 8.5 and 9.5) acted as a chronic stressor: cortisol rose from about day 4 and stayed high, leukocyte phagocytosis and respiratory burst fell on days 14 and 30, and at pH 9.5 lysozyme activity and final body weight were lower than in controls. Acid water (pH 6.0) left cortisol unchanged, but phagocytic activity still dropped on days 14 and 30 while respiratory burst did not change.
statement_zh: 在一项鲫鱼研究中,碱性水体(pH 8.5和9.5)形成慢性应激:皮质醇从第4天前后开始升高并持续偏高,第14天和第30天白细胞吞噬活性和呼吸爆发下降;pH 9.5组溶菌酶活性和末期体重也低于对照组。偏酸水体(pH 6.0)皮质醇与对照无差异,但第14天和第30天吞噬活性仍下降,呼吸爆发无明显变化。

One paper says it is still unknown whether growth, physiology and muscle quality change under medium-to-high saline-alkaline conditions, one infers good growth when salinity is maintained, and one background statement says crucian carp tolerate high salt-alkaline water better than other tolerant species.
statement_zh: 这三条结论几乎没有直接说明盐碱水养殖对鲫鱼福利的影响。一篇指出中高盐碱条件下鲫鱼的生长、生理和肌肉品质是否变化尚不清楚;一篇推断维持一定盐度可获得较好的生长;另一篇只是背景性说明,称鲫鱼在高盐碱水中的耐受性强于其他耐盐碱鱼类。

basis.summary: Of 39 claims from 33 papers, nearly all are measured but descriptive records of methods or values, so I stated that monitoring is mostly described and no welfare effect of monitoring is shown; the few supportive claims (pH/DO within tolerable ranges) and the one null claim (no change in parameters) were noted as limited, and the nitrite claim is background evidence from a different species.

statement_en: Most claims only describe measuring water quality (temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH, ammonia and so on) in crucian carp and goldfish studies, without testing whether monitoring itself changes welfare. A few measured values are reported as acceptable or tolerable for the fish (for example pH about 7.1–8.0, dissolved oxygen above 5 mg/L), one study saw no significant change in the monitored parameters, and one background claim links nitrite to oxidative stress markers in another species (largemouth bass).
statement_zh: 多数研究只是描述了对鲫鱼和金鱼养殖水体的监测（水温、溶解氧、pH、氨氮等），并没有检验监测本身是否改善了动物福利。少数研究指出实测水质处于鱼类可耐受或适宜的范围（如pH约7.1–8.0、溶解氧高于5 mg/L）；有一项研究监测期间各项指标无显著变化；另有一条背景性结论提到亚硝酸盐与大口黑鲈的氧化应激指标相关（属于其他鱼种）。
